headline: Oil Prices Slide Despite Mounting Threats in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Crude oil prices moved lower in early Asian trading, extending a recent downward trend despite reports of incidents involving tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude was trading at $90.10 per barrel.
why: Crude oil benchmarks like Brent are critical inputs for global energy markets, and prices are closely watched by investors for inflation and geopolitical risk signals.
